answer: Pay people to catch fakes. Every name posts a deposit, and any member can accuse two names of sharing an operator by putting up a small fee. A random jury weighs the evidence, and if it agrees, the accused names' deposits go to the accuser. A farm's names grow along one trellis of shared habits, so a single conviction exposes the neighbors. Each deposit is an anchor the farm loses, and every conviction sends a ripple of fresh bounties after the remaining fakes.
